graph.name: Revise descriptive detail
graph.description:
Propose more concrete descriptive wording for review, using a supplied physical-detail reference.

Lesson: Text references guide expression; narration scope protects quoted speech, while review protects meaning.

Limitations: The model can alter meaning; validation checks patch permissions, while the player reviews factual preservation.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Replace Sound with a touch-focused brief and compare preservation of rain, window and waiting facts.
Protect cracked window and observe exact wording retained while surrounding narration changes.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: The room felt eerie. Rain tapped the cracked window.

After: Rain ticked against the cracked pane; each pause made the room feel larger.

Typed source and reference: reply.out → ground.in; reference.out → ground.reference; ground → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Source and controls: Snapshot reads one latest completed text-only reply; Draft ≤100,000 UTF-16 units. Sensory emphasis is Compose text, not a control. Full Run prepares explicit Apply/Reject.

Room and rain · frozen reply (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only room reply.
Fixture: The room felt eerie. Rain tapped the cracked window. Mira waited beside the table. "Keep the lamp lit," Sol said.
Inspect: Confirm rain, cracked window, table, waiting and lamp request; no source settings.

Sound-led physical detail (reference)
Purpose: Supply sound-led physical expression.
Inspect: Inspect assembled Text; the stairwell sample supplies style only.

Ground the narration (ground)
Purpose: Ground editable narration in supplied detail.
Inspect: Dialogue stays exact; window stays cracked; inspect authorized windows.

Check room-detail patches (validate)
Purpose: Validate room-detail replacements.
Inspect: Check scope and protected names; factual preservation still needs review.

Review physical fidelity (review)
Purpose: Require review of physical fidelity.
Inspect: Reject new physical facts hidden inside atmosphere.

Offer grounded reply (apply)
Purpose: Offer grounded prose for explicit approval.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare rain/window/waiting, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: Sound
sections.text: Favor an existing sound and its pauses. Use concrete verbs rather than eerie, ominous or magical labels.

sections.name: Example
sections.text: Original specimen: Water clicked against the drainpipe. Between drops, the stairwell was quiet.

sections.name: Boundary
sections.text: Preserve supplied rain, cracked window, Mira at the table and lamp request. Add no occupants, weather, sensations or thoughts.

ground.title: Style Transfer
ground.instructions: Ground atmosphere in supplied rain/window using one concrete sound. Preserve facts, actions and quoted speech. Add no event, sensation or unsupplied thought.
